MOA: B1 selective → ↑ cAMP → ↑ [intracell Ca] → ↑ contractility
Clin Use:    - Acute HF		- Intermittent therapy  in CHF
▪︎acute AR: inotrope w nitroprusside - bridge to surg
▪︎acute MR: inotrope w nitroprusside - bridge to surg
▪︎unstable sinus brady: DA or EPI infusion if atropine ineffective
▪︎cardiogenic shock: β1 ↑contractility - β2 vasodilation may worsen BP - SBP <90 on dobutamine: add NE
▪︎EPI: alt when dobutamine unavailable - ↑acidosis · tachy · dysrhythmias vs NE + dobutamine
Direct Acting - bind adrenoreceptor → mimic NE/EPI
